claim: In the profiled system, all-to-all communication accounts for only 14.5% of communication time, while pipeline point-to-point transfers (36.7%) and tensor-/data-parallel AllReduce (48.4%) dominate; DualPipeV's overlap of expert-parallel all-to-all with computation targets a cost that is not the bottleneck.
falsifier: On a system with a similar communication profile, measure the impact of overlapping all-to-all with computation on overall communication time to verify its effectiveness.

conditions: communication time breakdown: all-to-all 14.5%, pipeline point-to-point 36.7%, AllReduce 48.4%
exclusions: Evidence is limited to the reported NPU system and communication profile; transfer beyond these conditions is unestablished.

title: DualPipeV's overlap of expert-parallel–ineffective optimization…
